purpose: This table is a cleaned, deduplicated-by-construction lookup of the sixteen airline carriers that flew out of New York City airports in 2013, mapping each carrier's two-letter code to its full legal name for joining against flight-level fact tables.
usage: Join downstream flight tables on carrier to resolve the full carrier name; both carrier and name are required, non-null columns with a 1:1 mapping (16 distinct carriers across 16 rows), so no null-handling or deduplication logic is needed by consumers.
limitations: The source profile shows zero nulls and zero duplicate rows across all 16 records, so no data-quality exclusions were necessary; the three Airbyte capture-metadata columns were dropped and are not available downstream.
